gloss: tree radical (木); the left-hand "tree" radical in kanji

definitions.gloss: tree radical (木); the left-hand "tree" radical in kanji
definitions.explanation: The kanji radical {木|き}, the {偏|へん} (left-side) form of the character for tree. It appears in many kanji related to trees, wood, and wooden objects, such as {林|はやし}, {森|もり}, {村|むら}, {机|つくえ}, {板|いた}, and {柱|はしら}.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{林|はやし}→林：01702_hayashi⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧きへん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧だ。
examples.english: "林" is a kanji with the tree radical.

examples.japanese: きへん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Kanji with the tree radical often relate to trees or wood.
"村" is written with the tree radical plus 寸.
The name "柏" is written as the tree radical plus 白.

notes:
The name literally means "⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧-⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧" (tree-left-side-radical). Like other radical names, きへん is usually written in hiragana when cited or described in speech.

USAGE:
Native speakers routinely use radical names to describe kanji verbally — for example, when giving a rare surname over the phone or clarifying a character: きへん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白|はく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「⟦{柏|かしわ}→柏：26146_kashiwa⟧」. This is a standard conversational tool for disambiguation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- きへん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧: a kanji with the tree radical
- きへん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜: tree radical next to 〜 (used when spelling out kanji)
- きへん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to have the tree radical attached

KANJI WITH THIS RADICAL:
Common examples include ⟦{林|はやし}→林：01702_hayashi⟧ (woods), ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧ (forest), ⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧ (village), ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧ (desk), ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧ (board), ⟦{柱|はしら}→柱：05009_hashira⟧ (pillar), ⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧ (bridge), ⟦{松|まつ}→松：02256_matsu⟧ (pine), and many more.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦にんべん→にんべん：23624_ninben⟧: person radical ({亻|にんべん}), another common left-side radical
- ⟦さんずい→さんずい：09495_sanzui⟧: three-drops-of-water radical ({氵|さんずい}), used in water-related kanji
- ⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧: the general term for left-side radicals
- ⟦{部首|ぶしゅ}→部首：00023_bushu⟧: radical (general term for kanji components)
